iterations.goal: Day-scale iterations become real: the parallel executor makes the drawn systematic machine runnable, and the retro flow arrives (notes drain + cleanup, field-feedback first).

steps.text: parallel executor: token-set instances, fired-edge activation, all-fired-input joins, offer queue, runtime seeding of iteration sub-machines, gate-template injection, packet method-link resolution, market flag - the drawn systematic machine becomes runnable

parallelism early (it speeds us up): the board's machine panel renders parallel branches side-by-side (today the render collapses them into one column - the drawing already has them); the executor's token set lets two agents hold two active states of one iteration
plan insert/renumber ops: planned iterations renumber freely, started ids are frozen (engine-checked); rides the dry_run -> execute lane
link graph + rename ripple: warm index over all markdown links incl. section targets; renaming a note or a section updates every inbound link (se.set.refactor kind=rename)
search scope parameter: se_file_search/read/list over declared roots (imports, v1, the owner's working folder) - declared, never arbitrary

retro flow v1 - runs as the drawn M0 onboarding (onboard_retro -> gate_kickoff): field-feedback question first, notes inbox drained, call log and se_help misses mined; ONE kickoff handover carries goal, scope and rigor; the engine serves a GENERIC log aggregation lane (filter/group/count over the logs) - the retro's counts, clauses and misses are one query on it, not a baked-in report; no ad-hoc scripts at retro time; standing question: has the process gone stale (state-of-the-art, process dimension)
policy derivation: lean re-derived as a strike-list from systematic - diffable, per the walkthrough ruling
projection: last_verify picked by timestamp, not folder order
boot cleanliness: the toll never blocks a session's first se_boot; se_boot refuses without a named project and its refusal tells the agent to ask the owner; one-question ritual per the contract
toll v2: update required on se_loop_submit; wall-clock floor tightened to ~5 min; toll and update-field text teach proactive updates (a volunteered update is never stopped)
se-gate: record role not username@hostname; loud message on expired offer
apply-lane ergonomics: dry_run optional (fire-first philosophy), execute-by-hash without resending ops, surgical canvas ops (add/remove node and edge)

1s interactive rule (req-1s-interactive): every se call answers within 1s or returns a background handle; first offender fixed: engine-filled states (verify suite) run inline in next() - move them to background runs; full-suite verification belongs to milestone verification states ONLY, never inline, never between milestones
call log hygiene: failures log clause + short reason (the retro ranks clauses); fix the double-logged dispatch lines
engine hot reload: mtime-keyed dynamic import behind the stable stdio shim - retires the /mcp reconnect chore (dev mode)

test lane machine-scoped: testing goes through the MCP server and is REFUSED outside a milestone verification state; inside one, a single call runs the suite as a background run (supersedes the pre-commit-anytime note)

commit lane gate-bound: se_git commit is REFUSED except in the window from a gate bless until the next loop submit; an explicit owner grant is the emergency escape (ruled 2026-07-24); the rhythm is verify (full suite, fix what trips) -> gate -> bless -> commit (supersedes the commit-freely ruling)

state inheritance (ruled 2026-07-24): product-level artifacts (vision, context, stakeholders, stories) are ledger nodes - the book and documentation reference them; machine states CHECK SUFFICIENCY and amend, never re-fill; inherit evidence is a pointer plus the delta or unchanged; se.vision is the first resident; state-note guidance swept accordingly
process lane: list/stop/cycle se-owned processes (board, engine child) - retires ad-hoc netstat/taskkill
offer lane: dismiss/supersede a stale offer; re-offer replaces when machine state is unchanged
contract bake: gate parking arms a watcher on offer.json; boot's already-admitted branch pokes the board
bless the executor behavior against the drawn machine at the gate
retro shape: answer the field-feedback opener
